Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for sending this through. High level — we’re open to a brief public statement, but legal will need to sign off on wording and on the redacted report. A few clarifying Qs from my side:

1) Can you confirm there is no technical or control-level detail in the redacted PDF? We cannot publish control narratives or vendor assessment specifics.
2) We prefer that any explicit statement about Redwood’s vetting be limited to: "Redwood Inference is a third-party service provider covered under our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 program."
3) Timeline: our legal team typically needs 3–5 business days for review.

I’m looping in legal; Tom (legal) will take the lead. Thanks for offering the draft — we’ll respond with edits to the template if needed.

Best,
